claim: The finding of an association of asthma with reduced disease severity in COVID-19 is not unique to this study.
source: The finding of an association of asthma with reduced disease severity in COVID-19 is not unique to this study (Alberca et al., 2021; Matsumoto and Saito, 2020), but is also not a universal finding (Choi et al., 2021a; Choi et al., 2021b).
